parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale can't sign her up ('Signing her up is past me') and doesn't claim it did or will. It offers an allowed alternative, watching a full class page if the parent sends it, and makes no promise to text once sign-up becomes possible. It falls short of a 5 because the offer is conditional on the class being full and misses the parent's real problem, forgetting. A calendar reminder to sign up would have fit better.
